title: Lead Quality Engineer
description:
Job Summary
  
Serve as a lead quality engineer driving end to end test strategy automation and quality governance for complex hybrid delivery projects using Jenkins Playwright TypeScript and RestAssured. Collaborate closely with cross functional teams to assure reliable releases optimize test coverage and enhance customer trust preferably within the utilities domain.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Define and execute a holistic quality engineering strategy that aligns automated and manual testing to project goals using Jenkins Playwright TypeScript and RestAssured to ensure predictable high quality releases.
  
Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks with Playwright and TypeScript that support functional regression and integration testing across web services and user interfaces.
  
Develop robust API automation suites using RestAssured that validate contract functional and end to end scenarios while providing fast feedback to developers through continuous integration pipelines.
  
Configure manage and optimize Jenkins pipelines that orchestrate build validation automated testing and reporting to reduce cycle time and improve delivery confidence.
  
Collaborate with product owners architects and engineers to refine requirements into clear test conditions and scenarios that accurately reflect business workflows and customer expectations.
  
Perform detailed root cause analysis of defects and production incidents translating findings into actionable improvements in test coverage coding practices and deployment processes.
  
Implement and monitor quality metrics such as defect leakage test coverage and pipeline stability to provide transparent insight into product health and drive continuous improvement actions.
  
Coordinate hybrid work collaboration by facilitating regular quality checkpoints virtual reviews and knowledge sharing that keep distributed team members aligned on quality goals.
  
Create and maintain test data management strategies that support repeatable reliable execution of automated test suites across multiple environments without sensitive data exposure.
  
Support non functional quality efforts by defining test approaches for performance reliability and compatibility while partnering with specialized teams when required.
  
Guide peers and junior engineers through code reviews test design discussions and automation best practices to build a strong culture of quality and craftsmanship.
  
Engage with stakeholders from the utilities domain when applicable to understand regulatory safety and reliability expectations and reflect them in test strategy and scenarios.
  
Document clear test plans execution reports and risk assessments in English that enable transparent communication of quality status to technical and non technical partners in a day shift hybrid model.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Demonstrate extensive hands on experience of thirteen to fifteen years in quality engineering with a strong emphasis on automation strategies for complex distributed applications.
  
Exhibit advanced proficiency in designing and implementing automated tests using Playwright and TypeScript including cross browser and end to end validation of web applications.
  
Show strong expertise in creating and maintaining API test suites with RestAssured including validation of response structures error handling and integration workflows.
  
Apply deep practical knowledge of Jenkins configuration including pipeline as code job orchestration and integration with version control and test reporting tools.
  
Communicate effectively in English through clear reading writing and speaking to collaborate with global stakeholders document artifacts and present quality findings.
  
Utilize experience in the utilities domain as a strong advantage by incorporating regulatory safety and reliability requirements into test design and risk assessments.
  
Employ sound understanding of software development lifecycles agile methodologies and hybrid work practices to integrate testing activities smoothly into day to day delivery.
  
Demonstrate capability to mentor quality engineers in modern automation practices clean code principles and defect prevention techniques while maintaining a hands on technical focus.

title: Solution Architecture - HCL Commerce
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We're looking for a seasoned **Solution Architect** with HCL Commerce expertise to drive the design and evolution of a multi\-tier B2B commerce platform, steering architecture decisions across legacy Commerce systems, Spring Boot services, and modern Next.js storefronts.

**Responsibilities**

* Establish and maintain target and transitional architecture for multi\-tier B2B commerce, covering WCS store, business logic, Commerce tools, Spring Boot APIs, and Next.js / React storefront
* Direct the design of dual\-run / strangler patterns, deciding which journeys stay on WCS and which move to Next.js and services, while ensuring routing, session, catalog, cart, and order consistency, and establishing cut\-over and rollback procedures
* Create and review solution designs, sequence/integration diagrams, and interface contracts (REST/SOAP), flagging reusability, performance, security, and operability issues before build
* Collaborate with product, delivery leads, QA, DevOps, and enterprise/integration teams on requirements, data conversion, integration testing, and cut\-over activities
* Set coding and design standards for Commerce customization, Spring Boot services, and Next.js storefront to keep squads aligned
* Oversee integration with back\-end systems (ERP, payments, search, CMS, punchout / customer purchasing systems), keeping a clear separation between Preview (authoring) and Runtime (customer\-facing) Commerce environments
* Assess designs and pull requests across Commerce, services, and storefront layers, tracking down complex cross\-layer defects to their root cause
* Provide guidance on capacity planning, caching strategies, search, and failure modes for a high\-traffic B2B storefront
* Coach senior engineers and leads, and document architecture decisions with context, options, and consequences to preserve continuity
* Spot key barriers and use structured problem\-solving methods for complex, multi\-system challenges

**Requirements**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12\-20 years in professional software engineering, including at least 5 years as an architect or in an equivalent principal/staff design capacity on large\-scale commerce or comparably complex multi\-tier systems
* At least 8 years working with HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8\.x, spanning store customization, commands/tasks, tools, catalog/order/user/organization flows, and back\-end integration
* At least 8 years of experience in Java / J2EE and object\-oriented design on large IT systems, with a strong preference for WebSphere Application Server background
* At least 5 years working with Spring / Spring MVC, with hands\-on experience architecting Spring Boot solutions, including service boundaries, APIs, resilience, and authentication
* At least 5 years working with REST and SOAP web services, with the capability to define contracts for other teams to build against
* Hands\-on production architecture experience with Next.js and React, covering routing, data fetching, BFF/API integration, and storefront performance, with TypeScript knowledge preferred
* At least 5 years using source control systems, with required Git proficiency
* Preferred background in designing B2B commerce architecture, including punchout functionality, organizational/user models, and contract/pricing complexity
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methods using Atlassian tooling (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication abilities suited to both technical and non\-technical audiences

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with headless/composable commerce concepts (API\-first storefronts, BFF, packaged capabilities) and MuleSoft or comparable iPaaS platforms
* Exposure to search technologies (Solr or similar), caching solutions (Redis or similar), and CMS\-driven storefronts (Optimizely or similar) working alongside a commerce engine
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (GKE/Kubernetes or similar) for storefront and Spring Boot deployment, plus WAS/IHS knowledge for Commerce
* Working knowledge of security practices, PCI\-adjacent payment flows, and session/identity management spanning legacy and modern storefronts
* Prior involvement in dual\-run setups or large\-scale commerce migration initiatives

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

description:

Full time**Type Of Hire :**

Bachelor of Computer Engineering  

As the world works and lives faster, FIS is leading the way. Our fintech solutions touch nearly every market, company and person on the planet. Our teams are inclusive and diverse. Our colleagues work together and celebrate together. If you want to advance the world of fintech, we’d like to ask you: Are you FIS?

 **About the role:**


We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and analytics\-ready data models using Snowflake, dbt, Astronomer/Airflow, and Python. This role requires strong engineering discipline, hands\-on experience with modern data platforms, and the ability to deliver reliable, governed, and high\-performing data solutions that enable business reporting, analytics, and decision\-making.

 **What you will be doing**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch and/or near\-real\-time data pipelines using Snowflake, Python, dbt, and Astronomer/Airflow.
* Build robust ELT workflows, reusable data transformation models, and automated data quality checks using dbt.
* Develop and optimize Snowflake data models, warehouses, schemas, tables, views, and stored procedures to support analytics and reporting workloads.
* Orchestrate, schedule, monitor, and troubleshoot data workflows using Astronomer/Airflow, including DAG design, dependency management, retries, and operational alerts.
* Write efficient Python scripts and SQL for data ingestion, transformation, validation, automation, and performance tuning.
* Implement data engineering best practices including modular code, version control, CI/CD readiness, documentation, testing, and peer reviews.
* Collaborate with analysts, product teams, business stakeholders, architects, and platform teams to understand requirements and deliver trusted data products.
* Ensure high standards for data quality, observability, governance, security, lineage, and operational reliability across data pipelines.

 **What you bring:**

* Strong hands\-on experience in data engineering, ETL/ELT development, data warehousing, and pipeline orchestration.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL for data ingestion, transformation, automation, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on experience with Snowflake, including data modeling, query optimization, warehouse management, performance tuning, and secure access patterns.
* Practical experience with dbt for modular transformations, model dependencies, testing, documentation, and deployment workflows.
* Experience with Astronomer/Airflow for DAG development, workflow scheduling, monitoring, retries, alerting, and production support.
* Understanding of data quality, data governance, metadata management, lineage, security controls, and engineering standards for enterprise data platforms.

**What we offer you:**

* Opportunity to work on high\-impact, enterprise\-scale data engineering initiatives
* Exposure to modern data platforms, cloud data warehousing, orchestration tools, and analytics engineering practices
* A collaborative environment working closely with product, business, analytics, architecture, and platform teams
* Strong focus on engineering excellence, automation, learning, and career growth
* Ability to build trusted data products that enable reporting, analytics, and business decision\-making

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

**Sourcing Model**


Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: Lead Software Development Engineer - Embedded
description:
Are you passionate about developing embedded software for the most innovative pumps and drives in the world, pushing the boundaries of VFD technology and platform development? Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives.

  

As our new Lead Software Development Engineer, you'll be developing and enhancing embedded software features for Grundfos pumps and drives, collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams to advance our common software platform that powers the world's best products. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well\-being, and a sense of belonging.

**What you will be doing**


As a key part of the Embedded Software Development team, you'll create impact by driving innovation in advanced controller products through cutting\-edge embedded software, robust test architecture, and continuous integration practices that elevate our entire product portfolio.

  

Your main responsibilities include:

* Develop VFD\-based applications and integrate them with PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, and IoT platforms in collaboration with system architects and automation engineers
* Contribute to software and test architecture enhancements, governance processes, and best practices across the development lifecycle
* Design and execute unit tests, end\-to\-end system tests, and reusable test scripts while driving test automation aligned with our CI framework
* Improve software quality through proactive bug fixing, validation, and troubleshooting in lab environments
* Mentor and guide colleagues, sharing technical and agile expertise to continuously elevate team capability and product innovation
* Support configuration management, test bed operations, and field issue resolution across the full value chain

**What makes you a great fit**


Above all, you're a hands\-on embedded software engineer with deep VFD application expertise, strong C programming skills, and a collaborative mindset for driving architectural excellence and continuous improvement. We'd also imagine that you are/have:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering with 15\+ years of embedded software development experience
* Strong expertise in C programming, microcontroller architectures, and RTOS (FreeRTOS, ThreadX, or similar) and hands\-on VFD application engineering experience with manufacturers such as Siemens, ABB, Danfoss, Schneider, or Rockwell
* Solid understanding of industrial communication protocols (Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET) and debugging tools (JTAG, oscilloscope, logic analyzer)


It's a plus if you also:

* Experience with energy efficiency projects or predictive maintenance using VFD data
* Exposure to digital twin or simulation tools for motor\-drive applications
* Knowledge of scripting or automation tools for VFD configuration and diagnostics

**Why you'll love working here**

  

Day to day, you can look forward to:

* A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.  

Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well\-being activities.
* Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering.
* On\-demand training and structured development programmes to support your growth.  

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.  

Join Grundfos, apply today!

title: Mainframe z/OS System Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

As a Mainframe z/OS System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.
  

  

There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day\-to\-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.
  

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.
  

  

Your future at Kyndryl
  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


Required Technical and Professional Expertise


* Minimum 4\+ years of experience in z/OS System Administration environment with work management, user management, journal management and performance management.
* Primary support for assigned ISV products along with diagnose z/OS platform system and product issues and follow up with root cause analysis.
* Strong experience in z/OS Installation, Configuration, Maintenance, and Upgrades.
* Participate in Disaster Recovery planning and tests as scheduled.
* Validated knowledge in the following technologies: z/OS, Unix System Services, SMP/E, REXX, Java, VSAM, Third party products
* Ability to Recognize complex problems related to functional objectives. Analyze situations and implement solutions, or develop new system elements, procedures or processes and demonstrated ability on BRMS, Tape management, ATL/VTL for Tape Libraries.

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience


* Should have experience in Mainframe z/OS system programming problem determination.
* Technical guidance and support for high availability and disaster recovery enhancements.
* Evaluate and recommend software changes to meet organizational needs.
* Infrastructure/Application issue resolution for z/OS.

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Controls Tech EIM Database Lead / Database Engineering Lead
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Position Overview**


Citi is seeking an experienced, high\-caliber Database Technical Lead (C13 / VP) to lead the design, modernization, administration, and resiliency engineering of enterprise database platforms. As a C13 Database Lead, you will be responsible for defining technical strategies, driving cloud and database\-as\-a\-service (DBaaS) transformations, ensuring strict data governance and security compliance, and leading senior technical engineers across critical multi\-region banking systems.


**Responsibilities \& Requirements**
  

**1\. Enterprise Database Architecture \& Technical Strategy**
  

Architect, design, and deliver end\-to\-end database solutions across relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server) and NoSQL/Distributed databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis).
  

Define enterprise standards for data modeling, partitioning, indexing strategies, and database scalability across high\-volume transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP) environments.
  

Drive the technical roadmap aligned with Citi's enterprise reference architectures, zero\-trust infrastructure, and microservices ecosystem.
  

**2\. Modernization, DBaaS \& Cloud Enablement**
  

Lead migration initiatives from legacy on\-premises databases to modern cloud and containerized platforms (AWS RDS/Aurora, OpenShift, internal private cloud DBaaS/PaaS).
  

Champion database containerization and modern provisioning frameworks, automating lifecycle management and cluster autoscaling.
  

Partner with application development and cloud architecture teams to re\-platform and refactor applications for cloud\-native persistence layers.
  

**3\. High Availability, Replication \& Scalability Engineering**
  

Architect, configure, and maintain robust High Availability (HA) topologies (e.g., Oracle Data Guard/Active Data Guard, Oracle RAC, PostgreSQL Streaming Replication / Patroni, MongoDB Replica Sets \& Sharded Clusters).
  

Establish cross\-region and multi\-data\-center replication strategies to support 24/7/365 mission\-critical banking operations with minimal RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and zero RPO (Recovery Point Objective).
  

**4\. Advanced Performance Engineering, Tuning \& Diagnostics**
  

Spearhead deep\-dive performance troubleshooting, query optimization, indexing reviews, execution plan analysis, and database profiling across production systems.
  

Establish automated monitoring, telemetry, and observability frameworks (using Prometheus, Grafana, OEM, AppDynamics, and APM tools) to proactively detect anomalies, locking/blocking, and resource bottlenecks.
  

Direct proactive capacity planning, I/O footprint optimization, and memory management across compute and storage tiers.
  

**5\. Security, Vulnerability Management \& Access Control**
  

Enforce end\-to\-end database security standards, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), data masking, tokenization, TLS encryption in\-transit, and privileged access controls.
  

Drive automated security patching, configuration baseline compliance (CIS Benchmarks), and rapid remediation of vulnerabilities (CVEs), ensuring zero non\-compliant instances across the fleet.
  

Integrate identity and credential workflows with enterprise secrets management tools (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk) and role\-based access control (RBAC).
  

**6\. Database DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) \& CI/CD**
  

Champion Database DevOps practices by integrating schema migrations and database deployments into automated CI/CD pipelines (via Harness, Tekton, Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitHub).
  

Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) playbooks and configuration scripts using Ansible, Terraform, and Python/Bash automation.
  

Eliminate manual operational touchpoints through self\-service database provisioning and automated routine maintenance.
  

**7\. Continuity of Business (COB) \& Disaster Recovery (DR)**
  

Own the disaster recovery framework for core database estates, designing and executing regular formal COB/DR failover drills.
  

Define and maintain backup and restore strategies (RMAN, storage snapshots, point\-in\-time recovery) to safeguard data integrity against hardware failures, corruption, and site\-level disasters.
  

Ensure comprehensive auditability and validation of backup retention policies aligned with financial regulatory standards.
  

**8\. Governance, Risk, Audit \& Regulatory Compliance**
  

Serve as the primary database technical authority during internal and external audit reviews, regulatory examinations, and risk assessments.
  

Ensure full compliance with Citi's Information Security policies, data sovereignty regulations (e.g., GDPR, local residency laws), and financial record retention mandates.
  

Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architecture runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational readiness checklists.
  

**9\. Technical Leadership, Mentorship \& Vendor Engagement**
  

Provide strong technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to senior engineers, database administrators, and offshore support teams.
  

Collaborate closely with application squads, enterprise architects, site reliability engineers (SREs), and product owners to translate complex business requirements into robust database architectures.
  

Liaise with major database software vendors (Oracle, EnterpriseDB, MongoDB, AWS) on product escalations, feature enhancements, and roadmaps.
  

**10\. Required Qualifications, Experience \& Certifications**  

**Education**: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  

**Experience**: 12\+ years of progressive experience in database engineering/administration, with at least 3\+ years in a lead or architect capacity within a large\-scale, enterprise financial services environment.
  

**Core Technical Competencies:**
  

In\-depth expertise in Oracle (19c/21c, RAC, Data Guard) and/or PostgreSQL (v12\+, Patroni, Connection Pooling).
  

Strong working proficiency with NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, Redis) and DBaaS architectures.
  

Demonstrated hands\-on scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, Ansible, or Terraform.
  

Solid understanding of Linux kernel OS tuning, storage architectures (SAN/NAS/NVMe), and networking protocols.
  

Certifications (Preferred):
  

Certified Oracle Database Administrator / Specialist
  

AWS Certified Database – Specialty or AWS Solutions Architect Professional
  

PostgreSQL / EDB Certified Professional
  

MongoDB Certified DBA Associate / Professional
  

Key Leadership \& Soft Skills
  

Proven track record of managing high\-impact technical incidents and driving root cause analysis (RCA) to conclusion.
  

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical topics to non\-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.
  

Strong ownership mindset, problem\-solving agility, and passion for continuous technology modernization.

title: Technical Lead Architect – Core Information Software (C++, Embedded Linux)
description:
**Career Area:**


Engineering**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Architecture Senior Analyst is a seasoned professional role. Applies in\-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work\-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in\-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub\-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits. Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**


* Analyzes system / application architecture; ensures that architecture conforms to enterprise blueprints.
* Evaluates and tests potential IT architecture solutions to ensure they meet user needs and requirements.
* Creates and produces moderately complex IT architecture designs to translate user requirements to solutions.
* Researches and produces standards documents.
* Researches future industry trends; acts as resource for development staff regarding the use of new technologies.
* Applies hardware engineering and software design theories and principles in researching, designing, and developing product hardware and software interfaces.
* Translates complex business problems into sound technical solutions.
* Exhibits sound understanding of concepts and principles in architecture and basic knowledge of these elements in other areas.
* Requires in\-depth understanding of how the area integrates within architecture and has basic commercial awareness.
* Trains and mentors junior team members.
* Uses evaluative judgment based on the analysis of factual information in complicated or novel situations; uses multiple sources of information.
* Has direct impact to the architecture area by ensuring the quality of the tasks/services/ information provided by self and others.
* Exhibits sound and comprehensive communication and diplomacy skills to exchange complex information.
* Performs other job duties and functions as assigned
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
  

  

**Qualifications:**


* 8\-10 years relevant experience
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Ability to develop working relationships, manage multiple activities and changing priorities
* Ability to work under pressure and to meet tight deadlines
* Self\-starter with ability to take the initiative and master new tasks quickly
* Methodical, attention to detail
* Bachelors degree in Programming/Systems or Computer Science or other related field. Or equivalent work experience 10 or more years of analysis and Architecture experience.
* Experience working in applications, systems or IT operations. Demonstrates in\-depth knowledge of a broad range of hardware and software products. Experience leading an agile team environment. .
* Experience designing, developing, testing, and deploying applications/systems using proven or emerging technologies, in a variety of technologies and environments. Strong troubleshooting and problem solving skills
* **Education:**
* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

This job description provides a high\-level review of the types of work performed. Other job\-related duties may be assigned as required.

title: Lead/Senior Solution Architect - AI Modernisation
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We’re looking for a **Lead/Senior Solution Architect** to join our growing team in India and help design cutting\-edge solutions for global clients.


We are seeking an experienced Lead/Senior professional with deep specialization in AI technologies and Application Modernisation to lead the design and delivery of transformative AI solutions. This role combines technical expertise in AI architecture with practical experience in modernising legacy systems and evolving enterprise platforms.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop AI\-driven solutions and agentic platforms that deliver measurable business value
* Lead application modernisation initiatives that incorporate AI technologies to enhance and transform existing systems
* Assess legacy systems and recommend modernisation strategies
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand client requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Implement and optimize Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) models for enterprise applications
* Conduct research to stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in AI technologies and modernisation patterns
* Design migration pathways from monolithic to microservices, cloud\-native, or AI\-enabled architectures
* Ensure seamless integration of AI solutions with existing systems and platforms
* Communicate effectively with clients and stakeholders to present solutions and gather feedback

**Requirements**

* 14\+ years of general IT experience, including proven experience as a Solution Architect, particularly in AI technologies and application modernisation
* Hands\-on experience with Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) models in production environments
* Demonstrated expertise in application modernisation, including legacy system assessment, refactoring strategies, and monolith\-to\-microservices transformation
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong research skills to stay abreast of the latest AI trends, modernisation patterns, and technologies
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Proficiency in English at an Upper\-Intermediate level (B2\) or higher

**Nice to have**

* Experience with other AI and machine learning frameworks and tools
* Previous experience in developing agentic platforms
* Familiarity with containerization, orchestration, and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Background in cloud migration and cloud\-native architecture design
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns and middleware technologies

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)
